messages:
zoe: Wanted to capture follow-up for the multi-region handoff RFC. Operators requested a non-destructive preflight that proves no secrets or PII will leave origin region.

raj: Seen the issue: autoscaler prewarm in a different region caused a short residency violation in staging. We need a hard guardrail.

ida: Proposal: PREPARE -> REPORT -> APPROVE flow. PREPARE enumerates objects to prime and flags secret-backed items. PREPARE can run in dry mode (no token minted).

chris: Tokens: dry_token (metadata only) and prewarm_token (allows secret hydration if explicit consent). Both scoped to tenant+lease+region, single-use, short TTL. Data plane rejects any priming without a valid token.

zoe: Forcing tokens removes ambient priming from autoscalers. We must include claims: tenant_id, lease_id, target_region, consent_level. Validate X-Target-Region header against token.

raj: KMS note: we must not decrypt across regions. Two approved patterns: delegated KMS in target region (customer opt-in) or encrypted-blob replication with rewrap. Document both in RFC.

ida: Observability: emit prepare.reported and prewarm.requested events with token id, operator id, and attach the preflight CSV as an artifact.

chris: Error semantics for RFC: 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, 410 TOKEN_EXPIRED, 409 REGION_MISMATCH, 423 HYDRATION_BLOCKED.

zoe: Rollout: feature-flag, start with non-PII tenants, run 24h canary, then enterprise opt-in. Runbook: abort commit if secret hydration fails and notify compliance contact.

ops-bot: infra-bot: feature-flag "handoff-preflight" enabled in staging. Scheduled canary at 2026-04-12T02:00Z.

raj: Action items: Zoe draft RFC extension with API examples; Chris prototype token minting; Ida write KMS/consent doc; I'll add observability events and runbook steps.

zoe: Thanks all. This should make operator cutovers auditable and prevent silent residency violations.
